checks.name: 0b: a = (ahat*K-1)/(ahat*K) > 0
0c: ahat - 1 = t > 0  (ahat > 1)
0d: G(x,y) = 1 - a^{x+1}(K-y)/(K-1) for y>=1 (closed form)
1a: DxG(x,0)  = 1        * DxF(x,0)
1b: DxG(x,y)  = aK/(K-1) * DxF(x,y)  for 1<=y<=K
1c: DyG(x,0)  = (1/ahat) * DyF(x,0)
1d: DyG(x,y)  = aK/(K-1) * DyF(x,y)  for 1<=y<=K-1
1e: DxF(x,K) = 0 = DxG(x,K)  (only zero-gain direction; finiteness)
2a: DxF = p(1-a)(K-y)/K = p w /(ahat K^2) >= 0
2b: DyF = p/K > 0
2d: DxF(x,y+1)-DxF(x,y) = -p(1-a)/K <= 0
2e: DyF(x+1,y)-DyF(x,y) = -p(1-a)/K <= 0
2f: DyF(x,y+1)-DyF(x,y) = 0  (modular in y)
3:  G(x,K) = 1 for all x
4:  DxG(t,0) = DyG(t,0)  (= p(1-a); tie -> B picks B at every step)
P1: pair case dy=0,y=0:   dtilde = d  (= p(1-Q); zero iff dx=0)
P2: pair case dy=0,y>=1:  dtilde = aK/(K-1) * d  (both 0 iff y=K or dx=0)
P3: pair case dy>=1,y>=1: dtilde = aK/(K-1) * d
P4: pair case dy>=1,y>=1: d = (p/K)[(K-y)(1-Q)+Q dy] > 0 (finiteness ok)
P5: pair case dy>=1,y=0:  d = (p/K)[K(1-Q)+Q dy] > 0
P6: pair case dy>=1,y=0:  aK/(K-1)*d - dtilde = p(R-1) > 0
P7: pair case dy>=1,y=0:  dtilde - d/ahat = p t/(1+t) * [(K-1)(1-Q)+(dy-1)Q]/(K-1) >= 0
P8: all-pairs eta_u = ahat, eta_o = aK/(K-1)  (assembled from P1-P7,1b,1c,1f,1g)
5a: eta = ahat * aK/(K-1) = (ahat*K - 1)/(K-1)
5b: ahat = (eta(K-1)+1)/K inverts eta(ahat)
5d: greedy ratio 1 - a^K = U_K(eta) = 1 - (1 - 1/(eta(K-1)+1))^K
5e: ahat - 1 = (eta-1)(K-1)/K  (ahat>1 <=> eta>1)
6a: OPT = 1: F(0,K) = 1 and 1 - F(x,y) = p(K-y)/K >= 0
6b: greedy final value F(K,0) = 1 - a^K  [GEN+IND: trajectory y=0 by induction on tie identity 4; explicit simulation below for K=2..8]
6c: path O-move: DyF(x,0) = ahat * DyG(x,0)  => path eta_u = ahat, path eta_o = max(1,1/ahat) = 1, path error = ahat
